notes.title: Release Build 3.16
notes.content:
[h1]Dragons Legacy [/h1]
[h2]Build 3.16.1[/h2]

[list]
[*] Rebranded Day of Dragons Legacy Beta as Dragons Legacy, now has unique App ID and separate Dedicated Server (DoD Legacy B.15.4 saves are fully compatible with Dragons Legacy 3.16.1)
[*] Added Dedicated Server LAN support via bForceLAN=true config option
[*] Added World Ambiance Audio to Forgotten Forests Map
[*] Added missing Flame Stalker Baby/Juvi footstep SFX
[*] Reworked Spawn Menu Selections
[/list]
